svg.text: Homelab network design: redundant edge, collapsed core, EVE-NG on ESXi
Port group Management · ESXi mgmt + EVE-NG web UI
Sales 21 · IT 22 · Management 23 exist on every access switch, matching the AD OUs
2 routers (VRRP/CARP), 2 core switches (LACP between them), dual uplinks from every access switch
clients use the VRRP address .1 on the core switches; the cores send everything else to the routers' inside VIP 10.0.255.1
Promiscuous mode, MAC address changes, Forged transmits = Accept; each floor on its own vSwitch so floors don't merge outside EVE-NG
ESXi management and the EVE-NG web UI (vSwitch0), and the VPN on the Raspberry Pi, so you never lock yourself out
